mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND status = 1 AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) )
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND status = 1 AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND created_at < #{currentMonthStart}

SELECT DISTINCT assignment.user_id FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment WHERE assignment.assign_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND assignment.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND assignment.evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND assignment.base_amount IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_challenge_monthly_report monthly_report WHERE monthly_report.user_id = assignment.user_id AND monthly_report.year_month = #{yearMonth} ) ORDER BY assignment.user_id

SELECT assignment.assign_date, assignment.result, mission.mission_type, difficulty.difficulty_name, difficulty.score AS difficulty_score, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info previous_assignment WHERE previous_assignment.user_id = assignment.user_id AND previous_assignment.assign_date = DATE_SUB(assignment.assign_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND previous_assignment.result = 'SUCCESS' ) AS previous_success FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id LEFT JOIN tbl_mission_difficulty difficulty ON difficulty.id = assignment.difficulty_id WHERE assignment.user_id = #{userId} AND assignment.assign_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND assignment.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND assignment.evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND assignment.base_amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY assignment.assign_date, assignment.id
SELECT difficulty_name FROM tbl_mission_difficulty ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_challenge_monthly_report (user_id, `year_month`, total_days, success_days, monthly_longest_streak, best_weekday, earned_score, weekly_results_json, difficulty_results_json, calculation_version, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{totalDays}, #{successDays}, #{monthlyLongestStreak}, #{bestWeekday}, #{earnedScore}, CAST(#{weeklyResultsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{difficultyResultsJson} AS JSON), #{calculationVersion}, #{finalizedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_days = VALUES(total_days), success_days = VALUES(success_days), monthly_longest_streak = VALUES(monthly_longest_streak), best_weekday = VALUES(best_weekday), earned_score = VALUES(earned_score), weekly_results_json = VALUES(weekly_results_json), difficulty_results_json = VALUES(difficulty_results_json), calculation_version = VALUES(calculation_version)
mapper.select: SELECT `year_month`, total_days, success_days, monthly_longest_streak, best_weekday, earned_score, weekly_results_json, difficulty_results_json FROM tbl_challenge_monthly_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` < #{yearMonth} ORDER BY `year_month` DESC LIMIT 1
